documents.name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement
documents.summary: Protects confidential information two parties share for a stated purpose.

documents.name: Cloud Service Agreement
documents.summary: Selling or buying cloud software or a SaaS product.

fields.label: Cloud Service
fields.description: The cloud software or SaaS product being sold, e.g. Acme Analytics platform

fields.label: Effective Date
fields.description: Date the agreement starts

fields.label: Subscription Period
fields.description: How long the subscription lasts, e.g. 1 year

fields.label: Fees
fields.description: Fees and how they are invoiced, e.g. $2,000 per month, billed annually in advance

fields.label: Technical Support
fields.description: Support the provider gives, e.g. email support on business days

fields.label: Non-Renewal Notice Date
fields.description: How long before the subscription ends a party must give notice to stop it renewing, e.g. 30 days

fields.label: General Cap Amount
fields.description: Liability cap, e.g. fees paid or payable in the 12 months before the claim

fields.label: Governing Law
fields.description: US state whose law governs, e.g. Delaware

fields.label: Chosen Courts
fields.description: Courts for disputes, e.g. state or federal courts in New Castle, DE

documents.name: Pilot Agreement
documents.summary: A limited-time pilot or trial so a customer can evaluate a product before buying.

fields.label: Product
fields.description: The product being piloted

fields.label: Effective Date
fields.description: Date the agreement starts

fields.label: Pilot Period
fields.description: How long the pilot lasts, e.g. 90 days from the Effective Date

fields.label: Pilot Fees
fields.description: Fees for the pilot, e.g. None, or $5,000

fields.label: General Cap Amount
fields.description: Liability cap, e.g. $10,000

fields.label: Governing Law
fields.description: US state whose law governs, e.g. Delaware

fields.label: Chosen Courts
fields.description: Courts for disputes, e.g. state or federal courts in New Castle, DE

documents.name: Design Partner Agreement
documents.summary: Early product access for a design partner in exchange for feedback.

fields.label: Product
fields.description: The product the partner gets early access to

fields.label: Program
fields.description: What the partner does in the design partner program, e.g. monthly feedback calls

fields.label: Effective Date
fields.description: Date the agreement starts

fields.label: Term
fields.description: How long the agreement lasts, e.g. 6 months

fields.label: Fees
fields.description: Fees the partner pays, e.g. None

fields.label: Governing Law
fields.description: US state whose law governs, e.g. Delaware

fields.label: Chosen Courts
fields.description: Courts for disputes, e.g. state or federal courts in New Castle, DE

documents.name: Service Level Agreement
documents.summary: Target uptime, response times and service credits for a cloud service.

fields.label: Cloud Service
fields.description: The cloud service these service levels cover

fields.label: Effective Date
fields.description: Date the service levels start

fields.label: Target Uptime
fields.description: Monthly availability target, e.g. 99.9%

fields.label: Uptime Credit
fields.description: Credit when uptime is missed, e.g. 10% of monthly fees

fields.label: Target Response Time
fields.description: Time to respond to support requests, e.g. 4 business hours

fields.label: Response Time Credit
fields.description: Credit when the response time is missed, e.g. 5% of monthly fees

fields.label: Support Channel
fields.description: How the customer requests support, e.g. support@provider.example

fields.label: Scheduled Downtime
fields.description: Planned maintenance windows, e.g. Sundays 2-4am UTC

documents.name: Professional Services Agreement
documents.summary: Engaging a provider for professional services under statements of work.

fields.label: Services
fields.description: The services the provider performs

fields.label: Deliverables
fields.description: What the provider delivers, if anything

fields.label: Effective Date
fields.description: Date the agreement starts

fields.label: SOW Term
fields.description: How long the statement of work lasts, e.g. 3 months

fields.label: Fees
fields.description: Fees, e.g. $150 per hour, or $20,000 fixed fee

fields.label: Payment Period
fields.description: Time to pay an invoice, e.g. 30 days

fields.label: General Cap Amount
fields.description: Liability cap, e.g. fees paid in the 12 months before the claim

fields.label: Governing Law
fields.description: US state whose law governs, e.g. Delaware

fields.label: Chosen Courts
fields.description: Courts for disputes, e.g. state or federal courts in New Castle, DE

documents.name: Partnership Agreement
documents.summary: A business partnership: each party's obligations, trademark use and liability.

fields.label: Effective Date
fields.description: Date the partnership starts

fields.label: End Date
fields.description: When the partnership ends, e.g. 2 years after the Effective Date

fields.label: Company Obligations
fields.description: What the company will do

fields.label: Partner Obligations
fields.description: What the partner will do

fields.label: Territory
fields.description: Where each party may use the other's brand, e.g. United States

fields.label: Payment Schedule
fields.description: Payments between the parties, if any, e.g. 20% revenue share paid quarterly

fields.label: General Cap Amount
fields.description: Liability cap, e.g. $50,000

fields.label: Governing Law
fields.description: US state whose law governs, e.g. Delaware

fields.label: Chosen Courts
fields.description: Courts for disputes, e.g. state or federal courts in New Castle, DE

documents.name: Software License Agreement
documents.summary: Licensing on-premise or installable software for a subscription period.

fields.label: Software
fields.description: The software being licensed

fields.label: Effective Date
fields.description: Date the agreement starts

fields.label: Subscription Period
fields.description: How long the license lasts, e.g. 1 year

fields.label: Permitted Uses
fields.description: What the customer may use the software for, e.g. internal business purposes

fields.label: License Limits
fields.description: Limits on use, e.g. up to 50 users

fields.label: Fees
fields.description: Fees, e.g. $10,000 per year, billed annually

fields.label: Warranty Period
fields.description: How long the software warranty lasts, e.g. 90 days

fields.label: General Cap Amount
fields.description: Liability cap, e.g. fees paid in the 12 months before the claim

fields.label: Governing Law
fields.description: US state whose law governs, e.g. Delaware

fields.label: Chosen Courts
fields.description: Courts for disputes, e.g. state or federal courts in New Castle, DE

documents.name: Data Processing Agreement
documents.summary: How a processor handles personal data under GDPR and similar privacy laws.

fields.label: Agreement
fields.description: The main agreement this DPA supplements, e.g. Cloud Service Agreement dated January 1, 2027

fields.label: Effective Date
fields.description: Date the DPA starts

fields.label: Nature and Purpose of Processing
fields.description: Why and how personal data is processed, e.g. hosting customer data to provide the service

fields.label: Categories of Personal Data
fields.description: e.g. names, email addresses

fields.label: Categories of Data Subjects
fields.description: e.g. the customer's employees and end users

fields.label: Duration of Processing
fields.description: e.g. for the term of the Agreement

fields.label: Approved Subprocessors
fields.description: Subprocessors the customer approves, e.g. Amazon Web Services

fields.label: Governing Member State
fields.description: EU member state whose law governs, e.g. Ireland

fields.label: Provider Security Contact
fields.description: Email for security matters, e.g. security@provider.example

documents.name: Business Associate Agreement
documents.summary: HIPAA terms for a provider handling protected health information.

fields.label: Agreement
fields.description: The main agreement this BAA supplements, e.g. Cloud Service Agreement dated January 1, 2027

fields.label: BAA Effective Date
fields.description: Date the BAA starts

fields.label: Breach Notification Period
fields.description: Time to report a breach, e.g. 30 days

fields.label: Limitations
fields.description: Limits on using or disclosing PHI, e.g. no offshore processing

documents.name: AI Addendum
documents.summary: Adds terms for AI services to an existing agreement: inputs, outputs and model training.

fields.label: Agreement
fields.description: The main agreement this addendum supplements, e.g. Cloud Service Agreement dated January 1, 2027

fields.label: Effective Date
fields.description: Date the addendum starts

fields.label: Training Purposes
fields.description: What the provider may train models for using customer data, or None if training is not allowed

fields.label: Training Restrictions
fields.description: Conditions on any training, e.g. data is de-identified first

fields.label: Improvement Restrictions
fields.description: Limits on using inputs or outputs to improve the service
